chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 37: Stealing Dragon Eggs from a Serpent-Elephant Beast
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen and the three skeletons steal dragon eggs from a rampaging Serpent-Elephant Dragon, causing chaos that engulfs Yan Qingcheng and other cultivators on Dragon Island.
og_description: Xiao Chen's daring theft of serpent-elephant dragon eggs triggers a beastly rampage, scattering cultivators across the island and setting the stage for new conflicts.
